items.title: Theodore Purnell Interview, 1972-06-16
items.q: Alvin Wall? You know Fats. Alvin Wall?

ctx.x: The Pichon used to come low by it. Is Alvin Wall in that Navy picture? Who?
Alvin Wall? You know Fats. Alvin Wall?
Yeah. You know, you know that one of the model pieces. Oh, you got him. I got somewhere around there. Yeah.
